info.title: Qosyl application API
info.description: Current application contract. Existing RPC selectors are retained for compatibility. Request fields and serialized response projections are generated from shared Zod schemas; role, ownership, state, cross-field, future-date and safe-URL checks remain authoritative on the server. Select x-view-response or x-action-response for the exact response of a requested selector. Auth endpoints under /api/auth/* are managed separately by Better Auth and are not redefined here.

post.summary: Preview a bounded official Threads keyword search
post.description: Fresh active admin, same-origin Origin, application/json; 2048 byte streamed body. Disabled by default; server-only token. One RECENT request, up to 25 normalized candidates, no paging, redirects or automatic retries. 10s timeout and 256KiB upstream body cap. Local technical ceilings: 5 calls/min/admin and 100/24h globally; failures consume quota. Provider throttling persists a shared pause. No Lead/Project is created or modified: operator explicitly fills and submits the existing lead form. Preview does not prove demand, consent or complete public coverage. 429 means local/provider throttling; 503 covers disabled/missing credentials, denied access, unavailable/invalid upstream or disabling during a call. No provider body, token or paging URL is returned.

post.summary: Record manual research, contact and consent outcomes
post.description: Admin only; current active role/account and verified email outside local mode are rechecked in a Serializable transaction. Requires same-origin Origin and application/json, maximum streamed body 32768 bytes. 60 committed mutations per minute per admin. Actions: createLead/editLead/assignLead/verifyLead/recordContact/recordConsent/revokeConsent/closeLead/reopenLead/addLeadNote. Every change except creation requires expectedVersion; one increment and immutable event are atomic. URLs are HTTPS, canonicalized without tracking and never fetched. Create deduplicates kind+URL even for archived/declined records without resurrection. New/edited expiry must be future and within 90 days. Consent requires a verified, manually contacted business request and an active client; discussions cannot become a project. Converted ownership cannot change. This API records human claims: no messages or projects are sent/created here.

get.summary: Read a public or authorized marketplace projection
get.description: Default view is catalog. project/work require id; applications requires projectId. Query selectors determine additional access checks: a cookie alone never grants owner/participant/admin authority. All reads are side-effect-free with respect to marketplace state. Only catalog/project permit guests.

x-view-access.backgroundJobs: Admin only. Read-only worker run history and non-secret scheduling configuration. This endpoint never runs background work.
x-view-access.pilotCosts: Admin only; paginated internal cost entries, all-history active totals and void count. No public journal access.
x-view-access.catalog: Public. Only current published projects of active clients; public field projection; demo visibility follows environment settings.
x-view-access.project: Public projection for a visible published project; owner sees own full fields. Participants and admins may inspect nonpublic projects; admin inspection does not reveal exact private location/contact.
x-view-access.dashboard: Active current user only; own projects, applications, notifications, and portfolio. Assigned student sees exact private location/contact only after both approvals.
x-view-access.portfolio: Active current user only; same private account projection as dashboard, including own consent states.
x-view-access.work: Project participants only, including when the caller is an admin. Private location/contact is revealed only to the owner or after agreement approvals.
x-view-access.applications: Client role and owner of projectId; applications are private to the owning client.
x-view-access.admin: Admin role only; moderation queues, safe users, reports and audit. Project contactPrivate/locationPrivate are excluded.
x-view-access.pilotMetrics: Admin role only; measured aggregates with demo exclusion. Missing view measurements remain null.

post.summary: Manage sources, review material and approve an explicit revision
post.description: Admin only; requires an active session, same-origin Origin and application/json. Maximum streamed body: 32768 bytes. Current active status and admin role are reread within the transaction; verified email is required outside local mode. Configuration and editorial safety decisions remain available while disabled. HTTPS on port 443 without credentials or fragments is required for input URLs, up to 2000 characters. Cross-field, allowed-host and state rules are checked on the server. Publication explicitly approves the latest revision with a bounded expiry. Import or edits never publish automatically; changed content is hidden until reviewed again.

x-action-access.setModuleEnabled: Admin only. Changes the collection and public visibility flag, initially false. Disabled hides all public opportunities. Does not approve revisions or start a network request.
x-action-access.createSource: Admin only. Up to 100 sources; a rights note and exact allowed hostname are required. Sources default to disabled. RSS requires a matching HTTPS feedUrl; manual sources have no feedUrl. No network request is made.
x-action-access.setSourceEnabled: Admin only. Changes an existing source flag; collection still requires the module to be enabled. No network request is made.
x-action-access.requestSync: Admin only; enabled module and enabled RSS source. Returns the existing queued/running run, or queues a new one if nextRunAt permits. The separate worker fetches the source later; this request never publishes or fetches content.
x-action-access.addManualContent: Admin only; enabled module and enabled manual source. URL hostname must exactly match the source. Stores plain text in a closed pending_review queue with immutable revisions; an identical current revision returns duplicate. Returning to earlier content creates a new revision. No publication or marketplace project is created.
x-action-access.reviewContent: Admin only. Requires expectedRevisionId and expectedUpdatedAt matching the current item. Decisions publish/reject/archive/withdraw/reopen require a reason of 10-2000 characters. Publish requires enabled module/source, pending_review and the latest immutable URL snapshot. Explicit expiresAt must be future and within 90 days, capped by earlier known deadline/eventDate. Other decisions remain available while disabled. Reopen is an explicit human action for a terminal item, never automatic import.
x-action-access.editContent: Admin only. Saves a new immutable editorial snapshot for an active item and moves it to pending_review, hiding any old publication. Requires current expectedRevisionId/expectedUpdatedAt and a reason. Retains prior approval and history; never edits historical rows. URLs must match the source host.

dueAt.description: ISO datetime; the server also requires a future deadline.

ContentAction_setModuleEnabled.description: Admin only. Changes the collection and public visibility flag, initially false. Disabled hides all public opportunities. Does not approve revisions or start a network request.

ContentAction_createSource.description: Admin only. Up to 100 sources; a rights note and exact allowed hostname are required. Sources default to disabled. RSS requires a matching HTTPS feedUrl; manual sources have no feedUrl. No network request is made.

ContentAction_setSourceEnabled.description: Admin only. Changes an existing source flag; collection still requires the module to be enabled. No network request is made.

ContentAction_requestSync.description: Admin only; enabled module and enabled RSS source. Returns the existing queued/running run, or queues a new one if nextRunAt permits. The separate worker fetches the source later; this request never publishes or fetches content.

ContentAction_addManualContent.description: Admin only; enabled module and enabled manual source. URL hostname must exactly match the source. Stores plain text in a closed pending_review queue with immutable revisions; an identical current revision returns duplicate. Returning to earlier content creates a new revision. No publication or marketplace project is created.

ContentAction_reviewContent.description: Admin only. Requires expectedRevisionId and expectedUpdatedAt matching the current item. Decisions publish/reject/archive/withdraw/reopen require a reason of 10-2000 characters. Publish requires enabled module/source, pending_review and the latest immutable URL snapshot. Explicit expiresAt must be future and within 90 days, capped by earlier known deadline/eventDate. Other decisions remain available while disabled. Reopen is an explicit human action for a terminal item, never automatic import.

ContentAction_editContent.description: Admin only. Saves a new immutable editorial snapshot for an active item and moves it to pending_review, hiding any old publication. Requires current expectedRevisionId/expectedUpdatedAt and a reason. Retains prior approval and history; never edits historical rows. URLs must match the source host.

Action_recordProjectView.description: Active student; visible unexpired real project. Owner, admin, and demo views are ignored. One immutable first view per student/project; replay is safe.

Action_recordPilotCost.description: Admin only; records a cost entry. Per-actor UUID idempotency key replays identical input; changed payload conflicts. No payment or revenue is inferred.

Action_voidPilotCost.description: Admin only; records the first void with a reason. Original cost fields and history remain immutable.

dueAt.description: ISO datetime; the server also requires a future deadline.

Action_createProject.description: Client role; creates a draft owned by the current user.

dueAt.description: ISO datetime; the server also requires a future deadline.

Action_updateProject.description: Client role and project owner, before assignment; published changes require moderation again.

Action_submitForModeration.description: Client role and project owner; draft or paused state.

Action_moderateProject.description: Admin role; pending moderation only. Rejection requires a reason of at least 10 characters.

Action_applyToProject.description: Student role; published, unexpired project of another active user; one active application.

Action_updateApplication.description: Application author; active application on a published project.

Action_withdrawApplication.description: Application author; active application on a published project.

Action_selectApplicant.description: Client role and project owner; published project and active application; exactly one selected student.

Action_approveAgreement.description: Project participant; exact current agreement ID; approves only for the caller.

dueAt.description: ISO datetime; the server also requires a future deadline.

Action_proposeAgreement.description: Project participant; state permits changed terms; creates a new immutable version.

Action_toggleMilestone.description: Project participant; milestone belongs to the project and relevant agreement.

Action_submitDeliverable.description: Student role and assigned student; both participants approved the terms.

Action_requestChanges.description: Client role and project owner; latest submission, specific agreed criteria.

Action_acceptSubmission.description: Client role and project owner; latest submission in submitted state.

Action_acknowledgePayment.description: Participant. Client reports payment; assigned student confirms receipt only after the client report; either may dispute. No money is transferred.

Action_closeProject.description: Participant after acceptance; completion requires both participants to close.

Action_cancelProject.description: Participant in an allowed state; preserves history.

Action_disputeProject.description: Participant in an allowed state; creates an audit trail, not a financial arbitration payout.

Action_setPortfolio.description: Participant of an accepted project; content changes reset publication consents.

Action_consentPortfolio.description: Participant; expectedUpdatedAt must match the reviewed version; public visibility needs both consents.

Action_createReview.description: Participant of an accepted project; one review of the other participant; author and recipient are server-selected.

Action_fileComplaint.description: Active user; at least one target (projectId or targetUserId); target access and complaint rate limits apply.

Action_moderateClient.description: Admin role; verifies or rejects an existing client profile; rejection requires a reason.

Action_suspendUser.description: Admin role; cannot target self or another admin; reason required; suspension revokes sessions.

Action_resolveReport.description: Admin role; existing open report; resolution does not rewrite payment statements.

Action_pauseProject.description: Project owner with client role, or admin; published or pending moderation; reason required.
